immutable_rules: Do not reduce quotas or weaken gates.
Features and claims begin failing or unverified.
Reviewers may not approve their own implementation.
passes:true requires a command that exited 0 with hashed evidence.
Critical and high defects block closure.
Evidence must exist and match its recorded hash.
Remote mutation and destructive actions require explicit operator authorization.
The shipped artifact must pass its clean smoke path.

profile_contract.description: Short campaign: executable command-backed features, halt list, clean zip. No marathon quota floor.
profile_contract.name: sprint
